  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The command can derive a replacement fix for an INCORRECT proposal without the deeper investigation procedure that /investigate-issue uses.

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
